question: Is any expiation available for one who has fallen from Kula?
premises: A person may fall from Kula.
Expiation would be a remedy for such a fall.
No expiation is seen anywhere for such a person.
inference: Falling from Kula is presented as having no available expiation.
plain_english: O Lady of Gods, no expiation is ever seen anywhere for one who has fallen from Kula.
